answer.why: As an insider, 'Confirmed & Substantive' made me laugh straight away because it is exactly the wording of a civil service appointment, when you stop being 'acting' and finally get the real title. It tells me the developer knows how things work. 'Minister Salary' is the obvious hook, but it feels like clickbait and I have heard that joke at every kopitiam since 2012. I would still be a bit wary of getting the details wrong, but the name earns it more trust.
answer.expect_minister_salary: A satirical, slightly cheeky game about the million-dollar ministerial pay debate. I would expect a gimmick: chase the top salary, maybe a benchmark-to-top-earners mini-game, and a lot of obvious jokes. It could be fun, but I would expect it to be shallow on how the service actually works and to treat it as a punchline. The grade progression might be a thin wrapper around the pay number.
answer.expect_confirmed_substantive: A dry, insider game about career progression in the public service, with waiting for confirmation, acting appointments, appraisals and ranking. I would expect gentle humour about process and wording, and a niche audience of civil servants and the people who know them. It might confuse outsiders, but I would expect more accuracy and more texture than the other name promises.
